test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question: Six representatives from different countries sat opposite each other diagonally opposite a round table. The Indian representative was to the right of the Russian delegate, but he was to the left of the American representative. The Australian representative was right in front of the Indian representative, but he was to the right of the South African representative and to the left of the Canadian representative. Which representative was sitting in front of the South African representative?
solution:
From the given information:

1) The Indian representative was to the right of the Russian delegate, but he was to the left of the American representative. 

2) The Australian representative was right in front of the Indian representative, but he was to the right of the South African representative and to the left of the Canadian representative

So the final arrangement is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37fb1822654881a7f2aa4caa2ab3fc816372ba7ae531610165f577ea8d9eb9b8.png] 

Hence, **"Russian Representative"** is sitting in front of South African representative.
